newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX electricity trades lower in thin volume.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX electricity trades lower in thin volume.

text.p: NYMEX electricity futures were trading lower Monday in thin volume with many traders taking Veterans Day off, industry sources said.
December California Oregon Border (COB) was trading down three cents at $23.55 per megawatt hour (MWh), while January was offered at $21.25 from Friday's settle at $20.89 per MWh.
December Palo Verde (PV) was trading down 20 cents at $21.55, while January PV was bid at $19.25 per MWh from a Friday settle at $19.50 per MWh.
NYMEX said as of 1145 EST, two PV contracts had traded. Updated volumes for COB were not available.
COB open interest for Nov 8 fell 84 to 3,900, while PV open interest rose 34 to 1,920, NYMEX said.
